services.name: Microsoft 365 (admin center)
services.note: This public endpoint only shows whether the Microsoft 365 admin center itself is reachable for admins — NOT whether Exchange, Teams, or SharePoint are down for users. It's a partial/backup signal. Real per-service, per-tenant status still requires Microsoft Graph (ServiceHealth.Read) with an app registered in Entra ID.

services.name: AWS
services.note: AWS doesn't have a single public JSON with CORS support; the Service Health Dashboard is split by region/service via RSS. Tell me which AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS...) and regions you use, and I can generate the specific RSS feeds.

services.name: Call Tracking Metrics
services.note: This provider doesn't expose a JSON API like the others (their status page renders the text directly in the HTML, on a different platform). The check looks for an 'operational' banner in the page text — less precise than a real API, so treat it as a best-effort signal.
